title: Issuing the pre-filled quantities marks the requisition issued but deducts no stock
steps: 1. Log in as admin. 2. Admin dashboard -> 'Issue Items' on an authorized requisition (e.g. 'Pens for IT helpdesk counter', ST001 x4, stock 10). 3. Keep the pre-filled quantity (4) and notes empty, click 'Issue Items & Complete'.
expected: FR-08/FR-10/BR-4: status issued, ST001 stock 6, one outward transaction (-4, balance 6), quantity_issued = 4.
actual: Status becomes issued and the success message is shown, but stock stays 10, no transaction is written and quantity_issued stays 0. Stock only moves if the Admin changes the number.
cause: RequisitionLineItemUpdateForm.__init__ puts the requested quantity into self.initial, so form.has_changed() is False and BaseModelFormSet.save_existing_objects() skips the unchanged form.

title: Any logged-in user (HOD, initiator) can issue items - IssueItemsView has no Admin role check
steps: Log in as hod_it, open /requisition/<pk>/issue/ for an authorized requisition, enter 3, submit.
expected: Only Admins issue (README separation of duties, assumption A1): 403, nothing changes.
actual: 200 - the page is served and the issue is completed: status issued, issuer = hod_it, stock deducted.
test: test_UT69_non_admin_cannot_issue; test_API_DT4_non_admin_cannot_issue; e2e SEC-03, SEC-06, SEC-08
cause: AdminRequiredMixin exists in requisition/views.py but is not applied to IssueItemsView (only LoginRequiredMixin via RequisitionMixin).

title: Admin can use the HOD approval view on any requisition, incl. moving an ISSUED requisition back to authorized
steps: Log in as admin, POST /requisition/<pk>/hod-approval/ action=authorized for a requisition in status issued.
expected: Only the HOD of the initiator's department may decide, and only on pending_hod (BR-2, BR-3).
actual: 302, status changes issued -> authorized; the requisition can then be issued a second time.
cause: HODApprovalView.get_queryset returns the unfiltered queryset when user.is_admin.

title: Two lines of the same item can together exceed stock and drive stock negative
steps: Authorized requisition with two lines of the same item (stock 5, requested 4 + 4); issue 3 + 3.
expected: BR-4: stock never negative; the combined issue must be refused.
cause: clean_quantity_issued validates each line against the stock value independently; no aggregate check and no select_for_update.

title: Create API is not atomic: unknown item id returns 500 and leaves an orphan requisition (update API: foreign pk -> 500)
actual: 500 'Server error: Item matching query does not exist.'; a requisition without line items remains. Update API on another user's requisition: 500 instead of 404.
cause: Header is created before the lines are validated and there is no transaction.atomic(); the broad 'except Exception' also swallows Http404.

title: Requisition update page: every UI POST crashes (AttributeError)
steps: Log in as user_it_1, open /requisition/<pk>/update/ of a pending requisition, submit the form.
actual: 500 - RequisitionUpdateView.form_valid reads cleaned_data of an unbound formset.
cause: form_valid builds the formset from get_context_data() (unbound) instead of from request.POST.

title: Update page crashes for a requisition without line items
steps: Open /requisition/<pk>/update/ for a requisition that has no lines (e.g. the orphan left by F6).
actual: 500 TypeError: BaseFormSet.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'extra'.
cause: extra is passed to the formset instance instead of formset_factory.

title: JSON create/update APIs lack type and enum validation (500s or silently accepted values)
steps: POST /requisition/api/create/ with purpose=12345, or items='not-a-list', or qty='abc', or qty=1.5, or uom='__not_in_enum__'.
expected: 400 with a validation message for each (OpenAPI spec).
actual: Non-string/non-list/non-integer -> 500 (AttributeError/TypeError/ValueError); qty 1.5 silently truncated to 1; unknown uom stored.
cause: Hand-written validation in the view assumes types; no form/serializer validation.

title: Create/update API accepts inactive (discontinued) items
steps: POST /requisition/api/create/ with the id of an inactive item (ST099).
expected: 400 - inactive items are not selectable (the UI form filters is_active=True).
actual: 200 - requisition created with the inactive item.
cause: API uses Item.objects.get(pk=...) without the is_active filter used by the form.

title: Issue endpoint returns 500 for a tampered/unknown line id or broken management form
steps: POST /requisition/<pk>/issue/ with items-0-id of another requisition's line, or a non-numeric items-INITIAL_FORMS.
expected: 200 with a form error; nothing persisted.
actual: 500 RelatedObjectDoesNotExist (clean_quantity_issued reads self.instance.item of an unsaved form).
cause: clean_quantity_issued assumes the bound instance is an existing line.

title: Item details API crashes when a type filter is given
actual: 500 TypeError: Cannot filter a query once a slice has been taken.

title: Cancel requisition changes state on a GET request (CSRF-able)
steps: While logged in as user_it_1, open /requisition//cancel/ (e.g. via a link or on another page).
expected: State changes only via POST with a CSRF token.
actual: The requisition is cancelled by a plain GET - no CSRF protection applies (SonarQube S3752 on cancel_requisition).
test: test_UT98_cancel_allowed_only_before_hod_action (shows GET cancels); SonarQube issue python:S3752 requisition/views.py:632
cause: Function view without @require_POST; template uses a link.

title: HOD form: server error for a missing reason is rendered inside a hidden section
steps: On the HOD approval screen choose Reject, bypass the browser 'required' check (or JS disabled), submit without a reason.
expected: Doc section 3: the error explains what to correct and is visible.
actual: Status unchanged (rule enforced) but the page re-renders with no action selected, so the reason section and its error 'Rejection reason is required.' are hidden.
cause: Template shows the conditional field only via JS state set by a click; it does not re-open the section when form errors exist.

title: README does not match the code (cancel reason, initiator editing, item-details parameters)
steps: Compare README 'Workflow' and 'API Endpoints' with requisition/views.py and inventory/views.py.
actual: (1) cancellation 'with the reason recorded' - no reason field exists; (2) initiators 'cannot modify once submitted' - code allows editing in pending_hod; (3) item-details 'accepts an item ID' - it takes q/type.
test: test basis assumptions A4, A5; review
cause: Documentation written ahead of / apart from implementation.
